profile.summary: Customer since 2020. Housing officer at a Leeds housing association; rents a room in a shared house in Headingley. Uses his linked PayPal wallet for most online shopping and subscriptions.

persona.persona: Colin Reid is a civic-minded housing professional who balances his intellectual curiosity for sociology and art with a tendency to fret over his heavy caseload and a love for Leeds United.
persona.professional_persona: A dedicated housing officer, Colin Reid blends a deep knowledge of UK housing legislation with an empathetic yet firm approach to guide vulnerable clients through bureaucratic hurdles. While he is highly proficient in case management, Colin Reid often carries the emotional burden of his caseload home, fuelling his ambition to move into senior management to influence systemic policy.
persona.cultural_background: Colin Reid grew up in a secular English household, rooted in the suburban values of West Yorkshire. His upbringing emphasised education and civic duty, which influenced his decision to work in the public sector. He identifies strongly with a modern British identity that values intellectual curiosity and social progress, often spending his weekends exploring the eclectic mix of galleries and independent venues that Leeds offers.
